screen.sinanmap.map_settings.reset.title: Reset settings
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.reset.messa: Reset all map settings back to their defaults?
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.info_or: Which lines show, and their top-to-bottom order
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.info_al: How those small lines line up with the minimap (left by default)
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.clock: Turn off to use a 12-hour clock with AM / PM
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.auto_zo: One block per device pixel; turn off to set the zoom by hand
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.lock_no: On: north stays up and only the arrow turns; off: the minimap rotates with you
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.layer: Show the surface or a cave slice; Auto follows your height
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.radar: Draw loaded mobs inside the minimap range as small heads
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.hostile: Only hostile mobs; passive ones (pigs, sheep…) are hidden
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.height_: Mobs above you are drawn semi-transparent, below you darker; same level stays normal
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.radar_i: All = each mob keeps its own head/item icon; No icons = every mob is just a diamond (friendly yellow, hostile red); Players only = only draw other players' faces
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.share_p: On a server that also runs Sinan Map, send your position to players who run it too (so they see you on the map); turning it off means you only see others, they don't see you
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.detail_: Finest world-map detail in blocks per pixel — lower saves VRAM and bandwidth
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.waypoin: Whether waypoint markers are drawn on the world map and minimap
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.keep_de: On: old death points stay and get renamed; off: only the latest remains
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.wayston: With Waystones installed, sync the ones you can use (activated / global / sharestones) into a waypoint group; turning it off clears that group
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.hud_sca: Auto uses the default size; turn it off to set the in-world marker size by hand
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.hud_dis: Whether an expanded in-world waypoint marker also shows its distance
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.km: Distances above this switch to kilometres (default 10000 m)
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.near_hi: Within this distance the label drops the distance line (turn off to always show it); default 25 m
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.near_sh: Within this distance the label always expands to the full name without having to look at it (turn off to expand only by looking); default 25 m
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.chunk_g: Draw chunk boundaries on the world map and minimap for chunk coordinates; hidden automatically when zoomed too far either way
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.grid_co: Color of the grid lines (semi-transparent); unused while the grid is off
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.slime_c: Tint slime chunks semi-transparent green; needs the world seed, so single-player saves only
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.cardina: Draw N/E/S/W just inside the minimap edge, rotating with the terrain (N stays up when north is locked); minimap only, not the world map
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.compass: Color of the N/E/S/W letters; unused while "Show cardinal directions" is off
Background behind the N/E/S/W letters (semi-transparent); unused while "Show cardinal directions" is off
Size multiplier of the N/E/S/W letters; unused while "Show cardinal directions" is off
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.overlay: Overlays (chunk grid, slime chunks, compass letters) are drawn on the minimap; click to adjust
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.prefetc: How many threads read map data from the save at once. More makes new terrain appear sooner but costs CPU; Auto is fine for most PCs
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.cave_th: How many threads scan cave terrain. More fills the cave layer faster; Auto is fine
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.applied: How many read blocks are drawn onto the map each frame. Higher fills faster but may lower FPS; lower it if it stutters
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.apply_b: Milliseconds spent on map loading each frame. Higher loads faster but may stutter; lower is smoother but slower
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.chunks_: Blocks advanced per page visit. Higher fills faster but several columns grow at once; lower grows in a cleaner line
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.filling: How many pages may load at once. Higher looks like everything grows at once; lower is more 'one page at a time'
screen.sinanmap.map_settings.tip.pages_p: How many pages advance each frame. Higher loads faster but more pages pop in at once; lower is tidier
screen.sinanmap.hud_edit.hint: Drag to move; drag a corner to scale, an edge to resize; arrow keys nudge position
